requirement: The system shall lock a user account after five consecutive failed login attempts within a fifteen-minute window.
The system shall hash user passwords using a slow adaptive algorithm with a per-user random salt before persisting them.
The user enters credentials on the login screen; the system verifies them and, on success, creates a session token and redirects to the dashboard.
The system shall enforce role-based permissions, granting access to a resource only when the user's role carries the required permission.
As an administrator, I want to reset another user's password so that they can regain access when they are locked out.
As a user, I want to enable multi-factor authentication using an authenticator app so that my account is more secure.
A user may only access resources belonging to their own tenant; cross-tenant access must be denied even for otherwise permitted actions.
Every login attempt, successful or failed, must be recorded in an audit log with username, source IP, timestamp and outcome.
The account table shall ensure that every username is unique, is not blank and has a recorded status from the recognised set.
code:
-- user account table for the identity service
CREATE TABLE user_account (
    account_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    username        VARCHAR(64)  NOT NULL,
    email           VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
    password_hash   VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT account_username_unique UNIQUE (username),
    CONSTRAINT account_username_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(username)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT account_email_unique   UNIQUE (email),
    CONSTRAINT account_status_chk     CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','LOCKED','DISABLED','PENDING_VERIFICATION')),
    CONSTRAINT account_hash_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(password_hash)) > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX account_status_idx ON user_account (status);

-- role assignment table
CREATE TABLE user_role (
    assignment_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id     BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    role_code      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    granted_at     TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    granted_by     VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT role_assignment_account_fk FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES user_account(account_id),
    CONSTRAINT role_assignment_unique UNIQUE (account_id, role_code)
);
-- session token table
CREATE TABLE session_token (
    token_id      VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id    BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    issued_at     TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    expires_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    revoked_at    TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT session_account_fk FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES user_account(account_id),
    CONSTRAINT session_dates_order CHECK (expires_at > issued_at)
);

requirement: Session tokens must expire automatically after a configured idle period and must not be renewable after absolute expiry.
The identity service shall produce a daily report of all currently locked or disabled accounts, with the reason and the time of the change.
